subject.title: fix(browser): tab creation steals window focus during agent automation

question: Should the extension relay treat a fully omitted Target.createTarget focus/background request as OpenClaw automation and default it to background, despite raw CDP defaulting that request to foreground?
rationale: Both choices are technically viable, and the correct answer depends on whether maintainers define the relay as an OpenClaw-owned automation endpoint or a generally compatible CDP proxy.

options.title: Accept automation default
options.body: Treat fully omitted requests as OpenClaw automation, retain the PR’s background default, and preserve raw CDP semantics for every explicit focus/background combination.

options.title: Preserve raw CDP omission
options.body: Keep omitted requests foreground-compatible and introduce a separate OpenClaw-owned signal or creation path for background automation tabs.

recommendation.title: Accept automation default
recommendation.body: Treat fully omitted requests as OpenClaw automation, retain the PR’s background default, and preserve raw CDP semantics for every explicit focus/background combination.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of adjacent CDP focus behavior makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the browser default-policy choice.
